title: Nothing CEO Carl Pei says memory is now the costliest phone component, accounting for 50%+ of BOM in some models, and predicts phone prices will rise into 2027 (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
summary: Stevie Bonifield / The Verge: Nothing CEO Carl Pei says memory is now the costliest phone component, accounting for 50%+ of BOM in some models, and predicts phone prices will rise into 2027 — With RAM getting more expensive, Carl Pei says holiday discounts probably won't be the same this year.
